answer: Sybil resistance requires each agent to bind its identity to a hardware-backed key and remote proof of an approved MRENCLAVE, with policy limiting identities per attested platform. VM copies can duplicate code and state, but cannot forge that platform’s attestation; scaling identities therefore entails acquiring and provisioning physical silicon, not cloning virtual machines. Attestation offers a haven for integrity, not immunity to collusion or a hollow claim at any graph vertex.
